So the break is scheduled and the original viewer got the ad. The late joiner doesn't get the ad.

Looking at scenario 2 (no CUE-OUT), the avail is not detected. The player would see the slate content. This matches the bug.

But wait, the producer would typically keep the CUE-OUT marker as long as the first segment of the break is in the playlist. So scenario 2 (no CUE-OUT, but with break segments) is a producer behavior issue.

Scenario 3 (CUE-OUT present, but oppId is different) would result in a NEW decision being made. The player WOULD get an ad.
